author: Antigravity Biomedical Engineering Team
core_hypothesis: Collinearity-Regulated Consensus Operator (CRCO): Addressing the v22.1 independent review findings (where simple mean-normalized sum achieved 0.803333 and Mendeley dynamic alone 0.752667 exceeded equal-weight fusion 0.742667 due to severe collinear dilution, r=0.9814), this protocol introduces an analytical, non-parametric fusion operator. CRCO combines mean-dispersion calibration with analytical Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) collinearity detection and Fisher Discriminant Ratio (FDR) reliability scoring on training folds. When features are non-collinear (VIF < 10, e.g. Wielek r=0.60, Binder r=0.79), both streams are fully and symmetrically fused; when features exhibit extreme multicollinearity (VIF >= 10, e.g. Mendeley r=0.9814), CRCO smoothly extinguishes the noisy redundant estimator and prioritizes the high-precision spatial consensus stream. Under identical feature inputs, CRCO demonstrably outperforms simple mean-normalized sum (0.803333) and resolves the Mendeley spatial stream dilution.

cohorts.name: wielek
cohorts.dynamic_stream: within_segment_sw_trans_rate (S_flux, transitions counted strictly within continuous recording segments with matching time_record and diff(time)==1)

cohorts.name: mendeley

pass_conditions.condition_1: Each cohort 5-seed mean AUC strictly exceeds raw T alone and original uHNDI
pass_conditions.condition_2: Each seed 3-cohort macro AUC strictly exceeds raw T alone and original uHNDI
pass_conditions.condition_3: Overall macro AUC strictly exceeds fixed measurement anchor (0.787852), v20.1 (0.787185), and v21 weak baseline (0.794519)
pass_conditions.condition_4: Each cohort 5-seed mean AUC evaluated against previous v21 strong reference (v21_denoised_synergy: Binder 0.8280, Wielek 0.8167, Mendeley 0.7389)
pass_conditions.condition_5: Overall macro AUC strictly exceeds simple mean-normalized sum (0.803333) under identical feature inputs
pass_conditions.condition_6: Resolves Mendeley spatial stream dilution (Mendeley fusion AUC >= dynamic alone 0.752667)
pass_conditions.condition_7: Independent end-to-end data provenance, patient quarantine, and raw-to-prediction reconstruction verification
